rules.statement: A transfer on exigencies of service must be based on one of the three criteria specified in Clause 218, and the officer being transferred must be informed of the reasons behind the transfer.
rules.supporting_quote: The Petitioner who faced the transfer on exigencies of service was deprived of properly defending himself without knowing the real reason for his transfer, when compared to a transfer made on disciplinary grounds, where the officer is well aware of the reason for his transfer.
